title: Eolent conformance fixtures
description: Describes the test deployment that the conformance suite runs against: two tenants, the principals that can call it, and one tenant-scoped resource.

tenants.description: Two tenants that exist in the deployment.

principals.description: Callers. Tokens are read from the environment variable named in tokenEnv; they never appear in this file.

host.description: Optional host principal that does not hold the tenant-switching permission.

hostSwitch.description: Optional host principal that holds the tenant-switching permission.

tenantALimited.description: Optional user of tenant A who holds none of the permissions of the resource and of the audit log.

resource.description: A tenant-scoped collection with create and get-by-id that the tests create and read.

updateBody.description: A JSON merge patch that changes the resource; needed by the concurrency and audit change tests.

permission.description: The permission that the create operation requires, as it appears in /api/v1/me/access.

sortProperty.description: A property that the list can be sorted by.

fixedTenant.description: True when the deployment under test has a fixed tenant, which is tenant A.

capabilities.description: Optional parts of the contract that the deployment supports, so the tests for them run.

culture.description: A culture, other than en, that the deployment has messages for.
